title: FraudShield: reference implementation and experiments for real-time fraud detection on PaySim
description: Code and results behind the MSc thesis "Development of a Real-Time Software System for Fraud Detection in High-Volume Financial Transaction Streams" (Lead City University). A runnable, fault-injectable reference implementation of an idempotent transaction-scoring pipeline, the feature scheme, and the PaySim experiments: two evaluation protocols, five seeds, a feature-group ablation, threshold-free metrics and latency benchmarks. The PaySim dataset is not included; it is available from Kaggle.
